name: ESP32 Wi-Fi Music Party
status: Fresh ESP-IDF v6.1 live audio candidate; follower stutter/popping remains unqualified; timing candidate installing
source_project_status: paused; preserve source, original backups and failed evidence
proposed_transport: Our own framing over raw IEEE802.11 broadcast non-QoS data frames, using public esp_wifi_80211_tx and filtered receive callbacks; feasibility candidate only
alternative: Our own application protocol over UDP multicast with standard Wi-Fi station networking if infrastructure is acceptable
host_stack: Pinned BlueKitchen BTstack; no CSB controller patches in the Wi-Fi candidate
audio: Preserve original SBC encoded bytes; local decode only; PCM5102A

requirements.simultaneous: Actual phone A2DP + Wi-Fi broadcast + BLE control traffic
requirements.hundred_receivers: design objective; two-board test cannot validate full-scale operation
requirements.latency_scope: phone to acoustic output on both source and receiver; latest user amendment supersedes250-380ms

first_gate: Instrument producer, API acceptance, raw TX completion, receiver callback, integrity validation and playback separately. Compare Bluetooth disabled, idle, active A2DP, and active A2DP+BLE with fixed radio/load settings. Preserve evidence before any reset. No framing or FEC change counts as a driver root-cause fix.
radio_limit: Wi-Fi, BR/EDR and LE still share the single 2.4 GHz radio. No claim of three-way audio qualification.
runtime_ownership: Admitted COM6/COM7 only; per-port dashboard leases for runtime and flash; existing YouTube plus own BLE-only phone test

raw_transport_scope.not_exposed_by_public_api: arbitrary PHY waveform or guaranteed application-owned RF time slots
raw_transport_scope.material_coexistence_limit: ESP-IDF5.5.3 marks Wi-Fi sniffer RX with BR/EDR and BLE as C1: supported but unstable. Must prove actual useful reception with A2DP and BLE before adopting raw RX.
raw_transport_scope.raw_api_limit: Public raw TX supports selected management frames and non-QoS data; encrypted802.11 and QoS raw frames are unsupported.
raw_transport_scope.first_gate: Two-board finite sequence/CRC-checked raw broadcast test while real phone A2DP and BLE controls remain active; record actual useful bytes/s, longest delivery gap, loss and source audio faults. No qualification from enqueue/callback or advertised PHY rate.

packetization.copy_spacing: time-spaced; provisional6ms for host planning, choose from measured burst gaps and available end-to-end latency
packetization.frame_duration: derived from actual negotiated samples/frame and rate;128 samples gives11.60998ms/group at44.1kHz and10.66667ms/group at48kHz

sdk: fresh official ESP-IDF v6.1 fff9895c82d744c7237be8847347bdd1b07c6643; no SDK patches
